Sorrow Wing is a blue rare mob wyvern found at the north end of Mirkfallon Lake in Stonetalon Mountains. Only hunters with the secrets to taming feathermanes can capture him.

:"The shadows will grant you another life; try not to waste it this time." :— Pidge Filthfinder Soulstone is a level 18 warlock ability. It stores a player's soul, allowing that player to resurrect. If the target is dead, it resurrects them.
Soulshatter is a warlock spell which reduces aggro on all targets within 50 yards by 90%.

:"The shadows will grant you another life; try not to waste it this time." :—Pidge Filthfinder Soulstones are bag-slot, conjured items, which a warlock can create beginning at level 18, that temporarily grant a buff on a target player conferring the power of self-resurrection. Often, the term is used as a verb meaning to apply a soulstone to a target.

Soulburn: Seed of Corruption is a passive specialization ability for Affliction warlocks, available at level 62. It allows Soulburn to work with the Seed of Corruption spell, causing its successful detonation to afflict Corruption on all enemy targets and grant a Soul Shard.
Soul Ward is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Soulrush is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Soulburn: Health Funnel is a passive Affliction warlock ability, available at level 27.
Soulburn: Curse is a passive Affliction warlock ability, available at level 73.
__NOTOC__ Soulbinder Aedraa is a draenei located at in Talador. She was killed by Vorpil Ribcleaver in order to obtain Auch'naaru from her. She is briefly seen at Light's Rest.

Soulare of Andorhal is a human who can be recruited as a follower to Lunarfall / Frostwall using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn / Frostwall Tavern. He can also be permanently found at Lion's Rest in Stormwind City. As his name indicates, he is from Andorhal. He wears an Argent Crusade tabard.
Souls of the Lost is an achievement earned from defeating Ner'zhul after slaying 2 Ritual of Bones skeletons within 5 seconds of each other in Shadowmoon Burial Grounds on Heroic difficulty.

The Soulkeeper is a jailer who appears to imprison the rogue player when they attempt to kill Akaari Shadowgore in the Shadowgore Citadel during Fangs of the Devourer (quest). The rogue is then taken to a holding cell, where they find themselves locked in a cage with the Soulkeeper floating nearby and undergoing a "Focused Trance", the ability description of which reads: "This unit is unaware of his surroundings." Using Pick Pocket, the rogue is able to obtain the Holding Cell Key, escape their cage, reclaim their weapons and break their way out of the holding cell. The rogue can choose to either kill the Soulkeeper or leave him to his trance, as his death is not required to progress through
Soulripper Warfiend are vilefiends located in the Shattered Fields in Krokuun.

Soulscreamer was a harpy who wanted to spread her foul curse throughout Highmountain. She also attacked Snowmane Village. She was killed by the Council of the Black Harvest and the other class orders.
Soulbinding Mist was sold for by Brewer Ahna and Brewer Goshi during Island Expeditions.

's soulbind interface, with conduits on the right]] Soulbinding is a system in which player characters can bind their soul to certain key members of the Shadowlands covenants, unlocking access to unique combat traits and bonuses. Additional rows of soulbind traits are unlocked by gaining Renown (Shadowlands) with the covenant. The power of the soulbinds can be increased by using conduit items at the Forge of Bonds found in each Covenant Sanctum.

Soulshape is an ability unlocked for members of the Night Fae Covenant. It changes the player's form into that of an animal, blinks them a distance forward, and temporarily increases their movement speed. Taking action other than blinking forward again while in Soulshape removes the buff and the transformation. Players can speak with Lady Muunn in Heart of the Forest to change the available soulshape look. Crittershapes are smaller Soulshape forms that are activated when it is used in a rest area. Choofa by the Heart of the Forest handles the Crittershapes, having options to swap forms or even deactivate the Crittershape effect. Since the arrival of the first mortal soul to Ardenweald, the W
__NOTOC__ The Soulforge Blueprints drop from mobs in the Maw with higher chance from more powerful enemies.
Souleater's Claw is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Soulborne Clasp is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Soul Tithe is a conduit for warlocks. It drops from the following bosses: *Nalthor the Rimebinder in the Necrotic Wake *Sire Denathrius in Castle Nathria *The Prototype Pantheon in the Sepulcher of the First Ones *Valinor in Bastion *Mortanis in Maldraxxus *Oranomonos the Everbranching in Ardenweald *Nurgash Muckformed in Revendreth. An ilvl 145 version is also rewarded from Strengthen the Bond.
Soul Sapper is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Soul of an Archon is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Soulburst Charm is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Soulforge Embers is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Soulrender of Zovaal is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Soulsteel Hasp is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Soulvoid Bag is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Soulward Clasp is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Soulsteel Pinion is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Soulforged Censer is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Soul of Iron is a cosmetic buff available only to characters on Season of Mastery realms that have never died. Defeating Ragnaros, Onyxia, C'Thun, and Nefarian will display a "survivor" text in the tooltip for other players to see. To obtain the buff, talk with Watcher Fero in the Hall of Explorers of Ironforge or Watcher Morta in the Apothecarium of Undercity. Dying with the buff will mark the end of the hardcore run for this character and mark them with the Tarnished Soul debuff. The debuff can be removed from the high elf watchers but the characters can no longer receive the Soul of Iron buff.

in Durotar.]] __NOTOC__ The Southfury River is likely Kalimdor's most prominent river. Beginning from a lake in Mount Hyjal, it drops into the regions below via a set of spectacular waterfalls. The resulting wide, swiftly-flowing river forms the boundary between the forest of Ashenvale and Azshara, and further south, the border between the Northern Barrens and Durotar. During the Cataclysm the river overflowed into parts of western Durotar, causing the flooded area to be renamed Southfury Watershed. The river empties into the Great Sea in a cascading waterfall just northeast of the goblin port city of Ratchet. There are three bridges that span the Southfury River: one crossing from Azshara i
Spackle Thornberry is a gnome warlock located in the cellar of the Slaughtered Lamb pub in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City.

The Southwind Helm is a leather helm with bonuses to strength, agility, stamina, and chance to hit. This is the best helm in the pre-Burning Crusade game (despite being blue) for a DPS feral druid and a decent helm for rogues.

Sovik is a goblin engineering vendor located in Nogg's Machine Shop in the Drag of Orgrimmar. Before the Cataclysm, he was located in the Valley of Honor. During the Siege of Orgrimmar, he was captured by the Kor'kron soldiers, being tied to a target, but soon released by the invading adventurers. He can be found in the Auction House in the Vision of Orgrimmar, throwing crates into a teleporter.

The Southern Barrens is the southern half of what was once the Barrens. Before being divided it extended into Northern Barrens without break; the two areas are now separated by the Great Divide. This region is not only one of the hardest hit by the Cataclysm, but also one of the biggest war zones in the escalating conflict between the Alliance and Horde. In the wake of the Cataclysm, the Alliance has been aggressively expanding into the heart of the continent from the east coast.

South Gate Outpost is a dwarven settlement built in western Loch Modan. It lies in the middle of the South Gate Pass, which links Dun Morogh in the west with Loch Modan in the east. Before the Cataclysm, the outpost was considered part of Dun Morogh. The mountaineers stationed at the outpost have cleared out most of the encroaching wildlife, and thus do not face the same amount of problems as do the dwarves of North Gate Outpost. Many travelers pass through the outpost on their way to or from Thelsamar.

Southridge Beach is located in central Azshara, lining the South edge of the Bay of Storms. It is heavily inhabited by the naga, but also supports makrura, hydras, murlocs, and the occasional sea giant. Countless ruins dot the beach, remnants of the once-great city of Eldarath.

__NOTOC__ s.]] Sparkleshell Snappers are turtles native to the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles. Being unable to swim, almost all these tortoises were killed during the Shattering, when Thousand Needles was flooded by the waters of the South Seas. Most of them can now be found dead, at the bottom of the now-called Shimmering Deep or floating in small groups at the surface. Only a few Stranded Sparkleshells survived the disaster, and are now roaming dry places like the path leading to Tanaris.
Sparkling Azure Moonstone is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting.
Lustrous Star of Elune is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting.
Southsea Cutthroats are humans, jungle trolls, and Dark Iron dwarves found on Fray Island in the Northern Barrens. Two are imprisoned at the Merchant Coast.

__NOTOC__ Southsea Cannoneers are humans and Dark Iron dwarves found aboard the Maiden's Dagger docked at Fray Island in the Northern Barrens. They could previously be found all over the Merchant Coast in the Barrens. Following the Cataclysm, one is found imprisoned at the Merchant Coast.
Southsea Privateers can be found on Fray Island in the Northern Barrens.

The Southfury Watershed is a large area in central western Durotar flooded during the Shattering and contains the polluted water from the Southfury River. It is a dangerous area densely occupied by quilboars, scorpids, crocolisks, and raptors. The region previously has an appearance similar to the rest of Durotar. It is bordered by the Southfury River to the west, the Razormane Grounds to the south, Razor Hill to the east, Razorwind Canyon to the northeast, and Tor'kren Farm and Thunder Ridge to the north. The zone of Northern Barrens is accessible from here by heading west across the Southfury river. In World of Warcraft, the Watershed is a questing area involved with the guard tower in the

Southpoint Gate (or Southpoint Blockade) is a Forsaken outpost in Hillsbrad Foothills, on the border with Silverpine Forest. Most notably this is where the adventurer for the first time becomes a quest giver dispensing out three quests for three different types of other "heroes". The area surrounding the gate has been overrun by Domesticated Creepers, and Infested Bears now wander around with spider eggs on their backs. It was built over the now-destroyed Southpoint Tower. Horde champions encountered Darius Crowley at the Sludge Fields, where he led a Gilnean army against Hillsbrad. Given that, in order to reach the Sludge Fields the Gilneans would have had to go through Southpoint Gate, it

The Southern Rocketway Terminus is a station of the Bilgewater Cartel Rocketway, located directly south of Bilgewater Harbor and east of the Secret Lab. Like the northern terminus, it has a flight master, located at a small landing pad below the station. The Rocket-jockey will greet successful arrivals with, "Welcome to the Southern Rocketway Terminus! Home of the world famous Secret Lab!" Taking a rocket ride between this terminus and the northern terminus will award you Joy Ride. The terminus is useful to either get to Bilgewater Harbor for the first time, or to get to the Secret Lab.
If an ability is spammable, then it does not have a cooldown and is only limited in use by the global cooldown.

The Southern Isles extend south of the Forbidden Jungle in southwestern Krasarang Wilds. The zone can be found to the west of the Cradle of Chi-Ji. Despite the name, the Southern Isles in fact comprises only one major island, and a small sand and rock outcropping to its north. This discrepancy is fixed with later phasing.
The South Spire is a destructible building in southern Tol Barad. It can be destroyed with the two Abandoned Siege Engines that spawn nearby at the entrance to The Hole for more time.

's Sunset Shore.]] The South Sea (or the South Seas) is the large southern sea of found beyond and Talador, in between the continent of the orcs and the mysterious land to the southwest. It merges into the Evanescent Sea at the southern tip of the Spires of Arak.
South Seas Moonshine is sold by Jay Prath who appears at the Bloodsail Buccaneers' beach party on the Cape of Stranglethorn's Wild Shore during Pirates' Day.
The Sparkling Pool can be found in the waters of Shattrath City in Talador.
Plush]] The Souvenir Raptor is sold by the following in Suramar City for : * Dolse Shimmersong * Kieule * Sasunne Dameuse Using it summons a Stuffed Raptor Souvenir.
Southsea Gamblers are humans located on the expedition islands.
Sourback Hideout is a cave located in the Scrapbone Den on Mechagon Island. It is home to the Young Sourbacks.
Sourfang is the flight master for the Horde at Hellscream's Hope in the northwest part of the Jade Forest.

Southern Skies Platform is a flight master platform located in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn. It's run by Gyll. A Hero's Call Board is placed here, and a Zul'Gurub Protector Stone hangs on the building as well.
Sparkqueen P'Emp is a mechanical spider located on Mechagon Island. She only spawns when the world quest Bugs, Lots of 'Em! is available.
The Spark Reactor was the power source for the Annihilo-tron 5000 of King Mechagon. The Rustbolt Resistance requires it be recovered to resuscitate High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque.
Spark-1351 has a chance to drop from the following mechanicals on Mechagon Island: *Malfunctioning Scrap Pup *Malfunctioning Scrapboss *Malfunctioning Scrapbot *Malfunctioning Scraphound
Spark Nimblecog is a Mechagon mechagnome located on Mechagon Island.
Sparkling Glimmerfly are glimmerfliess located at the Citadel of Loyalty in Bastion. Picking them up affects you with Sparkledust which heals you and makes you faster for a short while.
Soulwrought Studs is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Sparkleshell Deathclaws are crabs that can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Speak with Shoni is a level 15 quest that leads players from Ironforge to Stormwind City (and eventually the Deadmines via its follow-up quest, Underground Assault).
Speckled Tastyfish are caught from all pools (inland or open ocean) on Northern Stranglethorn and the Cape of Stranglethorn during the Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza.

The Spawning Glen is located in deep southwestern Zangarmarsh. The sporelings, a race of sapient fungal creatures, have reared their young here for millennia. Recently, however, the fungal giants have begun destroying and consuming the helpless young of Sporeggar. Adventurers wishing to increase their reputation with Sporeggar can find ample opportunities here.

__NOTOC__ Spearcrafter Otembe is a forest troll master blacksmith in Tor'Watha in Eversong Woods. He is rumored to wield a hammer that is so light and imbued with magical properties that it allows him to strike with amazing dexterity and efficiency. Otembe has a very high uncommon drop rate while not being a rare spawn and can be easily farmed by low level blood elves seeking to get some silver or to level up enchanting.
Spaulders of Reclamation are epic leather shoulders for restoration and balance druids. Along with a Sunmote, it can be traded to Yrma for Spaulders of Devastation.
Spectral Citizens are human ghosts who perished in Stratholme when it was devastated by Prince Arthas, but don't even seem to realize they are dead.
Spawn of Uvuros are hostile fel beasts found in Shadowmoon Valley's Hand of Gul'dan. These hounds are the offspring of the patriarch Uvuros, who overlooks the valley from his favorite cliff.
Sparring is a passive Windwalker monk ability, available at level 42.
Sparkwing is a rare wind serpent located inside Boulderslide Cavern in Stonetalon Mountains.
Sparring Hall is a subzone of Shattered Halls. Groups of fel orcs fight each other in an armored hallway on grates over molten lava.
The Specter of Mugabu is a troll spectre located inside a storehouse in the northwestern corner of the Court of Zak'rajan in Vol'dun, performing some kind of magic on an inanimate Zandalari golem.
Sparkweave Shredders are mechanical spiders located on Mechagon Island.
Sparkweaver Ohms are mechanical spiders located on Mechagon Island.
The Spawning Pit is a chamber within the Maw of Gor'ma in Ny'alotha, the Waking City. It is found behind the Horrific Iris.
The Spawn of Vexiona was deposited into a player's inventory upon looting N'Zoth the Corruptor in Heroic or Mythic difficulty in Ny'alotha, the Waking City, prior to .
Spaulders of Miasmic Mycelia drop from Carapace of N'Zoth in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
__NOTOC__ Specimen 97 are mechanical squirrels found in Mechagon Island.
__NOTOC__ Spectral Flasks of Power are created with Alchemy (160); taught by trainers.
Sparks of Unwavering Strength are items rewarded from completing Horrific Visions. They are used to create or upgrade Essences.
Spaulders of Aberrant Allure drop from Il'gynoth, Corruption Reborn in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Spattered Soles is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Spearheads of Eternity is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Spattershield is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

__NOTOC__ Spellsteal is a mage class talent. This is a dispel effect that steals a magic buff from a target and gives it to the caster. The stolen buff will benefit the mage for up to two minutes, but never more than the duration remaining on the target from which it was stolen.

Spell Reflection is a tier 3 warrior class talent that reduces magic damage taken and allows the warrior to reflect a spell back onto the caster. It lasts for 5 seconds or until a spell is reflected, and can be used both offensively, and defensively.
Spellcloth is a cloth crafted by tailors. It is used to create set items with bonuses to spell power.

A location somewhere on Azeroth. The ocean has carved deep rivers in the land and formed what looks like a giant spider. Bridges offer one way to get around. However the best transporter around the area is of goblin manufacture.

Spectral gryphons are ghostly gryphons that aid players in transporting them to different locations. Before Cataclysm, it was first seen only in the Eastern Plaguelands alongside William Kielar, where it was used to fly to the other towers if the player's faction controlled Plaguewood Tower. These creatures were later seen in Northrend and Cataclysm zones for non-night elf players as transportation in certain zones while dead because of impassible terrain. Those areas are: *Crystalsong Forest *Icecrown *Storm Peaks, which includes all the instances *Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight (leaving this subzone will dismount you) *Mount Hyjal *Deepholm *Uldum *Twilight Highlands

Spellfire Tailoring is one of the Tailoring Specializations you are able to choose in Shattrath City. Spellfire Specialization allows you to create two units of Spellcloth/Spellweave instead of one using the same amount of materials and grants access to Spellfire-specific tailoring recipes. This specialzation is geared towards fire/arcane mages.
The Spellfire Gloves are cloth gloves that boost Spellpower and critical strike rating.

Spell hit is an attribute that increases a caster's chance to hit with offensive spells (healing abilities never miss, and are not affected by spell hit chance). Spells that fail to hit are shown as a "miss", and have no effect on their target. With the removal of hit and expertise from gear, players automatically have a 100% chance to hit creatures up to and including 3 levels above the attacking character. However, if players attempt to attack targets 4 or more levels above their character level, their spells may still miss, as shown in the table to the right. For example, if a level 90 character attacks a level 93 target, the spell will hit. However, if the same level 90 character attacks

Spectral sight is a demonic, magical view of the world. Demon hunters, disciples of Illidan Stormrage, ritually blind themselves in exchange for spectral sight that enables them to better sense their prey. In the book, World of Warcraft: Illidan, demon hunters are revealed to be able to shift their vision to "perceive the world as [they] once did," from seeing the "ebb and flow of energies" and "auras of living things, some bright, some filled with energy" to "as if [they] had eyes" and "many gradations between." The demon hunter Vandel imagines Illidan "as he had previously seen him" and manages to see a "rough image of the Betrayer...like a child's illustration drawn in mud." According to
Spider's Bite is a pet talent located in the 4th tier of the Ferocity Tree.

Spellpower Elixirs are created with Alchemy (375); taught by trainers.

The deadly, tow-bladed swords of the spellbreakers strike fear in the hearts of wizards and sorcerers. The blood elves' elite warriors employ these frighteningly effective weapons to execute outlawed spellcasters, necromancers and other evil practioners of magic.
Spectral Guise is a talented priest ability, available at level 60.
Spectral Strike is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Speed Metal is a quest achievement earned for defeating after gaining 10 stacks of Power Surge, which is gained by killing Shan'ze Electrocutioners and running over their corpse. See his article for more information. This achievement is required for the meta-achievement, Stormbreaker.
Spectral Spine is an ability used by Spectral Porcupette during a Pet Battle.

Spelurk is a rare mistlurker located in the Mysterious Den of Timeless Isle. In order to summon the mistlurker, players must find one of the Timeless Legends on the isle, and use the provided bonus ability on the Cave-In. Should players somehow find themselves locked inside the mysterious den, there is a Rock-breaking Hammer on the inside that can be used to break the cave-in as well.
Spider Egg Sacs are egg cocoons found in Forgotten Caves in Gorgrond. Destroying it may spawn Venomfang Spiderlings or dead skeletons.

Speed of the Swarm was a pet ability available exclusively to the wasp family of hunter pets, increasing player haste by 5%. It was functionally identical to the sporebat family's Energizing Spores and the hyena family's Cackling Howl, but surpassed in effectiveness by the Savage Vigor of the rylak family, which provides additional Stamina. The Ancient Hysteria used by core hounds can provide a much greater boost to haste, but lasts for only a short time.
Spicy Sharp Cheddar is sold by Kurd Butterhoof in Highmountain. Dragon Isles cooks who have learned Ratcipe: Charitable Cheddar can use this cheddar to make Charitable Cheddar.
Spellbound Terrorguards are terrorguards found at the Ruins of Karabor in Shadowmoon Valley. They are summoned by Sunfury Summoners to train Demon Hunter Initiates.
__NOTOC__ Spellbinder Ulura is a twilight dragonspawn that can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Spectral Hankerchief is a quest reward from Words Have Power.

Spider's Watch is a small House of Eyes camp in the cliffs overlooking the House of Constructs in northwestern Maldraxxus. The Sepulcher of Knowledge is reachable by traveling further up the mountain path and through a tunnel to the east.
Spellbinder Goro is an ogre located in Molten Cay during Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Spellbound Ritualists are night elves and jungle trolls located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Spectral Oats is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Spellweaver's Mojo is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Spectral Handkerchief is a quest reward from Words Have Power. It is sold by Mistress Mihaela in Revendreth for and Darvel the Frugal in Oribos for .
Spheres' Harmony is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Spheres' Harmony.
Spell Focus Fragments are looted from nightborne at Moon Guard Stronghold in Suramar. They can be combined to form a Volatile Spell Focus.
Spellweaver's Dominance is a Devastation talent for evokers.
Spinebreaker Post is a small Horde outpost in southern Hellfire Peninsula to the east of the Expedition Armory and southwest of Zeth'Gor. It contains loads of quests and also has a Flight Path.

The Spiral of Thorns is located inside Razorfen Downs, and is where the dungeon's most powerful creature, Amnennar the Coldbringer presides over his loyal subjects. Glutton the abomination is also found here, on the lowest level of the spiral. Depending on whether the party takes a left or a right at the first fork in the dungeon, this area is accessed last or first, respectively. The only way to get to the top of the spiral is to follow its winding course around and around, battling the lich's undead minions along the way. The spiral has three full loops before it reaches the uppermost plateau.

The Spire of Blood is a ziggurat inside the Temple City of En'kilah. During the war against the Lich King, the San'layn High Priest Andorath could be found here on the second floor, performing dark rites in the spire. Adventurers were later sent by Thassarian for the Alliance, or by Chieftain Wintergale for the Horde, to kill him.

The Spire of Decay is a ziggurat inside the Temple City of En'kilah. During the war against the Lich King, the crypt lord High Priest Naferset could be found here, apparently feasting on the energies provided by the surrounding necromancers, while performing dark rites in the spire. Adventurers were later sent by Thassarian for the Alliance, or by Chieftain Wintergale for the Horde, to kill it.

The Spire of Pain is a ziggurat inside the Temple City of En'kilah. During the war against the Lich King, the crypt fiend High Priest Talet-Kha could be found here, mostly surrounded by crypt fiends, and performing dark rites in the spire. Adventurers were later sent by Thassarian for the Alliance, or by Chieftain Wintergale for the Horde, to kill it.

The Spine of Deathwing is the first of two confrontations with Deathwing in the Dragon Soul raid. The battle begins on The Skyfire as players leap onto the Destroyer's back, attempting to weaken his armor enough for their allies to attack, and ends when he is defeated and crashes into the Maelstrom. World first heroic kill achieved 17.12.2011 by KIN Raiders(즐거운공격대) - KR-Kargath.
Spiderling Swarm is an ability used by spiders during a Pet Battle.
Spiked Skin is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Spirit Beast Blessing was a pet ability available exclusively to the spirit beast family of hunter pets, increasing player mastery by an amount depending on level. It was functionally identical to the hydra family's Keen Senses, the cat family's Roar of Courage, and the tallstrider family's Plainswalking.
Spirit Claws is an ability used by Xu-Fu, Cub of Xuen during a Pet Battle.
Spiny Carapace is an ability used by Spineclaw Crab during a Pet Battle.

Spires of Arak is a zone in southern . Previously known only as Arak, it once contained a single massive spire that dominated the forested landscape, before it was sundered by the destruction of the Apexis' Breath of Rukhmar. It is the homeland of arakkoa, who rule over the land from the Skyreach, a majestic palace situated atop the largest spire in the area. Their society, however underwent a great schism between the winged arakkoa and the wingless, who are considered lesser beings by their winged brethren. Many of the wingless arakkoa flee the Spires and pour into Talador, while the Iron Horde's strengthens their presence. Many Azerothians also have built their bases along the coast, such

The Spire of Light is a building on the plateau high above overlooking the Sha'tari Market District. It is here that Lady Liadrin and lead the Sunsworn and the , respectively, in aiding the Sha'tari Defense in their efforts to reclaim from the , their forces in the city led by the treacherous former Exarch, Socrethar.
Spinesever's Spine drops from Spinesever at Rockaway Coast in Highmountain.
Spire Stabilizers are fel crystals in Mardum and Krokuun powering up spires of woe.
Spikey is Nagtar Wolfsbane's faithful ravager located in Dazar'alor and the Island Expeditions.
Spiderspring Gears drop from Steelarm Pillagers on Mechagon Island.
The Spine Guarded Supplies are a quest reward from Friendship Is Magic.
__NOTOC__ Spinetusk Piglets are boars located in Highmountain.

.]] :How you die can say a lot about how you lived. Spirit of Redemption is a passive level 29 Holy priest ability. Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec, taking on the appearance of a Spirit Healer hovering above their crumpled body. The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects. While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost. When the effect ends, the priest dies.

.]] .]] Spiritwalkers or spirit walkers are mystical, white-furred tauren casters. They can enter an "Ethereal Form", allowing them to avoid physical damage. Believed to be the ill omen of a coming age, white tauren are held in near reverence by their people, often becoming reclusive priests who wander the land in search of kindred spirits. Spiritwalkers maintain the balance between the world of the living and the spirit realm. They can travel into the memories of the dead to glean clues about the past. The Spirit of Zandalar is a buff given to characters in Booty Bay or Yojamba Isle when someone turns in the Heart of Hakkar. __NOTOC__ The Spirit of Shadowforge is one of the Dark Iron Thanes found in the Athenaeum in Blackwing Descent. He is the spirit of Iron Thane Shadowforge, who was by all accounts a cruel despot who tortured and killed many of his own people. He is generally held to have been a warlock, but some accounts cling to the rumor that he was one of the first dwarven shaman. The latter notion is supported by the spirit's use of Chain Lightning. Shadowforge's family has left a long stain on Dark Iron history. They share their name with Shadowforge City, the Dark Iron capital. Shadowforge's Lightbound Smock is named after the thane.

Splithoof Crag was the name of the Galak centaur village located against the northern wall of Thousand Needles, just east of Darkcloud Pinnacle. However, during the Cataclysm, the area became flooded. The surviving centaur founded a new village, Splithoof Heights, on the cliffs looking over the Shimmering Deep. After the Cataclysm struck, a few goblins did a survey of the area and found some gold-looking ore had emerged from underground. The crag is now littered with debris and underwater life, along the mountain side, in the center of the village, is a cavern known as Splithoof Hold. This is where the Cloven Hoof, an ancient artifact, was heavily guarded and protected by the Ancient Brazier

They cannot resist games, and the magical mischief they cause work similarly to faerie curses in that they must obey "the rules". They are seen regularly collaborating with boggarts, and appear to be taking orders from Mueh'zala. Despite all this, they are not entirely evil. The term stack in World of Warcraft generally refers to three different things: # A grouped number of the same items which take up only one bag or bank slot. # The ability for multiple buffs or debuffs to remain active at the same time. If they can work together, they can "stack". Some buffs and debuffs can be applied multiple times to stack with themselves. # Characters are "stacked" when they are so close together in the game world that they overlap.

Then use the rat every five minutes to pick up a Ripped Recipe Scrap or five. More Fine Aged Cheddar will keep the rat around. Stags are beasts, a type of deer. They are large animals, taller than humans, and have antlers. Most stags are when approached. Despite being herbivores, they are tough, fast, and territorial, and can provide a challenge for any hunter. Stags are common in forested areas throughout Azeroth. They are targets for humanoid hunters and natural predators like wolves, but their mighty antlers and ferocity make them difficult prey. Stags avoid conflict but can be aggressive in larger groups or when startled. Stag Meat when cooked becomes Lean Venison.

Stagalbog Cave is a large cave located in the Stagalbog in eastern Swamp of Sorrows. The cave used to be inhabited by many murlocs of the Marsh tribe and their leader, the Swamp Talker. After the Shattering a Faceless one, Hr'nglth the Lost, came onto shore and took refuge in the cave. As a result animals in the area began behaving oddly, acting more aggressively than usual and eventually making their way to the cave. A small camp of Steamwheedle Cartel goblins led by Baba Bogbrew lies outside the cave and immediately east.

Staghelm Point was a night elven tower found on the top of a peak in northeastern Silithus. During the Call of the Scarab micro-holiday, the Twilight creatures scale with player level. It was badly damaged following Sargeras' devastation on the region. The Alliance built a base near the road leading to the ruined tower, and later the Cenarion Circle joined its rebuilding efforts.

The Stair of Destiny is the massive foundation of the Dark Portal in Outland, located on the "edge of the world" in eastern Hellfire Peninsula. Before the destruction of Draenor, this location was a convergence of ley lines. Like Shattrath City, the Stair is a sanctuary, where PvP combat is disabled. See Dark Portal for information about the Portal's other side.
Stance Mastery is a passive warrior ability which allows the warrior to retain up to 10 rage when changing stances.
